_note: Copy and tiers of /pricing (app/pricing/page.tsx, components/pricing/*). PRICES (USD, one-time; user 2026-10-07, replaced 'from $1,200'): $500 per connection; take 3 connections or more and one of them is free (3 for the price of 2); set up in 1 day. The numbers live in lib/offer.ts (the tier cards and the counting example compute their prices from it); the sentences here spell them out, and lib/offer.test.mts checks that they agree. A tier's `count` is its number of connections (`plus`: that many or more). `badge` (null or a short label) puts a label on one card; only set it when it is true. Only true claims: one-time payment, full codebase handed over, unlimited orders and products, priced by connections, built on the existing engine, set up in 1 day. The real client stays anonymous and is told generically: no product-category words and no marketplace or warehouse brand names or logos on this page. Never name or compare with another vendor. The live demo and the case studies are never linked from this page (they are for email readers only).

items.title: $500 per connection

items.title: Built on our engine
